reviewContext.userProblem: Telescreen v1 judges content only. DSPM, DLP and secret-scanner products judge risk as content x placement x exposure, confirm resolution by rescan, treat unscanned as unsafe, route to data owners and track exceptions with expiry. The owner asked to adopt F1-F10 as specified in design-v1-1-dspm-adoption.md while keeping every v1 data-handling guarantee. F1-F10 code is integration-accepted; this run proves the remaining end-to-end flows and finishes the release.

designDecisionsAndRationale: R-1: version 1 stays the identity key; only value fingerprints use the active key version, so key rotation never re-keys issues or counts as remediation (O4: issue count unchanged, occurrences across key versions not linked).
R-2: issues.severity is the effective severity and base_severity is added.
R-3: PATCH can no longer set resolved or ignored; dedicated remediation, resolve and exception operations replace it.
R-5: exception approval through /api/exceptions by teams.lead_member_id or an admin.
R-12: rescanner reports inconclusive for incomplete content; verify rescan keeps pending_verification and writes verification_inconclusive with to_value CoverageState.UNSUPPORTED.value (R2).
Design section 4 rule 1: any matching violate policy decides over a matching allow (P2).

O1: owner_review outcome remove writes verification_requested and sets pending_verification without a drain; assertions read the DB before any drain because a rescan of unchanged content would reopen the issue.
O3: SlaCheckHandler records sla_breached 'below risk threshold' and keeps tier_index when risk_score < min_risk.

New c3 manifest supersedes c2 because c2 was already dispatched in session 4; c3 records p01-p20 as acceptedDependencies (p07 at af943da for the owner fix) and dispatches only p21 with its declared artifact roots.

The src drift check compares against 809b02d and accepts exactly the owner-committed decider.py fix.
supportedEdgeCases: Policy allow with max_age_days holds while fresh and reverts to unresolved after the clock passes the limit (P1).
Matching violate next to matching allow: violate wins; allowed -> unresolved with policy_reevaluated (P2).
Rescan with binary content is inconclusive and never resolves (R2); resource gone (404) records resource_deleted.
owner_review not_mine releases a member assignment back to the default team (O2).
min_risk escalation below threshold is skipped; equal threshold fires (O3).
Fingerprint key rotation with version 1 as identity key keeps issue identity (O4).
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Live PostgreSQL/Meilisearch behavior beyond marked integration tests skipped offline.
